description: Use the project owner admin key (ga_...) to remove a teammate's access immediately, invalidating their member key or pending invite. Safe to repeat. Invite links and keys are shown once; to restore access, create a new invite.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_revoke_member
title: Revoke a team member
